description: Pixel font shortlist for the dungeon roguelike: two candidates per role. Use only at the listed native size or whole multiples of it, with antialiasing and hinting off.

fonts.name: Alkhemikal
fonts.author: jeti (Font End Dev)
fonts.credit_text: Font "Alkhemikal" by jeti (fontenddev.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
fonts.notes: Legible in ALL CAPS and mixed case; also works for headings and boss names.

fonts.name: Jacquard 12 / Jacquard 24
fonts.author: Sarah Cadigan-Fried
fonts.credit_text: Fonts "Jacquard 12" / "Jacquard 24" (c) 2023 The Soft Type Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1
fonts.notes: True blackletter, more ornate. Hard to read in ALL CAPS; use Title Case.

fonts.name: Pixel Operator
fonts.author: Jayvee Enaguas (HarvettFox96)
fonts.notes: Very readable; digits and punctuation clear.

fonts.name: m5x7
fonts.author: Daniel Linssen
fonts.notes: Narrower; fits more text per line on a phone screen.
